description: FIG ACRO Table of Difficulty 2025-2028, Women's Group balance: transitions between two pyramids, printed page 52 (PDF 55). The lookup uses only the BASE values (from tod-wg-bases.json), not the whole pyramid (coach, 2026-11-14): the table's left column is the 1st base's value and picks the row `i`; its top row is the 2nd base's value and picks the column `j`. `values[i][j]` is the transition value when the 1st base's value is in `ranges[i]` and the 2nd base's value is in `ranges[j]`; the table is not symmetric. A range [30, null] means 30 or more. On the sheet the transition value goes in the open cell between the two pyramids (value C). Transcribed from the PDF's text layer and checked against the page; every row increases and no column decreases.
